_help: Knobs for the curator. Safe to edit. Every episode sent to your queue is sent once and never again.
_budget: About 10 a week: roughly 3 regulars plus up to 7 discovery picks.
_exploration: Each week Claude proposes new adjacent people, shows, and topics. Up to explore_per_week of the discovery picks come from them. Terms expire after expansion_ttl_days unless they prove themselves.
_regulars: Episodes that always get sent. Weekdays: 0 Monday ... 4 Friday, Eastern time. Other episodes from these shows need others_min_score.
